checks.name: table row counts
checks.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items)

checks.name: low stock order
checks.sql: SELECT product_id,stock FROM products WHERE stock<15 ORDER BY stock,product_id

checks.name: null city
checks.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE city IS NULL

checks.name: COUNT ignores null
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(city),COUNT(*) FROM customers

checks.name: outer join zero orders
checks.sql: SELECT c.name,COUNT(o.order_id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

checks.name: grouped units
checks.sql: SELECT c.name,SUM(i.quantity) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING SUM(i.quantity)>=3 ORDER BY c.name

checks.name: total units
checks.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

checks.name: top two stock
checks.sql: SELECT product_id,stock FROM products ORDER BY stock DESC,product_id LIMIT 2

checks.name: transaction script restored state
checks.sql: SELECT stock FROM products WHERE product_id=101

checks.name: practice row rolled back
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_id=99

checks.name: window numbering
checks.sql: SELECT order_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_id) FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id,order_id
